RUN TIMELINE (read from run_log.json, one chip per guardrail attempt)
Run 1: live model, with a revision round
Run 2: offline replay (scripted model, same checks)
WHAT IS REAL AND WHAT IS SCRIPTED
Real: a live model wrote the brief, the lines and the reviews through the same agents. The checks blocked 2 Dialogue attempt(s) (29 errors) before the third passed.
The first review returned REVISE (2 checks failed: Daniel stays in the basement; No significant outpost detail). Its 6 issues went back to the Dialogue agent, who changed 10 lines (kept 46 verbatim).
The revision passed the same guardrail first time and the re-review returned PASS (14 of 14 checks). The re-reviewer is the same model marking its own fix, so creator approval is still needed.
Two checks were added after run 1: a line's step must match its event's step, and a reviewer's line counts must match the data. Output was not copied into the game project.
